proposed_fixes.title: Distinguish Outlook windows during workspace launch and placement
plan: Use a disposable classic Outlook profile with three views and capture launch/window-arranger correlation.
Trace Launcher repeated-instance waiting and WindowArranger matching using application identity, window title and captured position; distinguish reused windows from new windows.
Only after the failing match is demonstrated, adjust matching/waiting without promising a general arbitrary launch order; add a multiple-window regression.
verification: Launch the captured Mail/Calendar/Contacts workspace repeatedly and verify each intended window reaches its own saved rectangle.
Compare cold Outlook, already-running Outlook and move-existing-windows modes without exposing mailbox data.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Multiple windows of the same Outlook process may be matched or timed out before the intended view is identifiable, resulting in swapped placement; the exact matching failure is unconfirmed.

confidence.rationale: The supplied archive shows repeated Outlook launches and a repeated-instance wait timeout, but titles/arguments are partly private or redacted and the failed matching branch is not yet proven.

fix_assessment.rationale: Reproduce with a disposable Outlook profile and correlate each view/window to its captured rectangle before designing a matching fix.

judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce with a disposable Outlook profile and correlate each view/window to its captured rectangle before designing a matching fix.
evidence: The report supplies screenshots and a diagnostic ZIP for Mail, Calendar and Contacts opening in incorrect zones.
The archive contains three classic Outlook entries and launcher/window-arranger logs; launcher logs include a repeated-instance waiting timeout.
judgment.rationale: The supplied evidence supports a targeted maintainer reproduction rather than another general ZIP request. Avoid a speculative global launch serialization or a claim that FancyZones itself chose the wrong zone.

reproduce.expected_result: Each intended view is placed at its saved rectangle; launch-order differences alone are not failure unless they cause incorrect view/placement.
steps: 1. Save a workspace with the three Outlook windows in distinct rectangles.
2. Close Outlook and launch the workspace.
3. Record actual view-to-rectangle mapping, then repeat with Outlook already open and with move-existing-windows enabled.
reproduce.title: Reproduce three Outlook workspace windows
prerequisites: Windows with classic Outlook and a disposable test profile
setup: Open Mail, Calendar and Contacts as separate Outlook windows and capture their positions.
Use harmless test mailbox data; do not publish account/window-title contents.
